{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  -- Start from the company model
  SELECT 
    c.component_code AS part_code,
    c.name AS part_name,
    c.is_assembly,
    uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
    c.unit_cost
  FROM company_model cm
  JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = cm.model_code
  JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
  WHERE cm.model_code = 'VI5-180WHT63-0257'
    AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Recurse into assemblies
  SELECT 
    c.component_code AS part_code,
    c.name AS part_name,
    c.is_assembly,
    bt.qty_per_unit * uc.qty AS qty_per_unit,
    c.unit_cost

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
  -- Start from the bundle SKU, find all item SKUs directly in it
  SELECT 
    'sku' AS parent_kind,
    parent_code AS parent_code,
    child_kind,
    child_code,
    qty AS path_qty
  FROM u_composition
  WHERE parent_code = 'BDL-UK-0265'
    AND parent_kind = 'sku'
    AND valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Continue recursively: explode through model -> component and assembly -> component edges
  SELECT 
    c.parent_kind,
    c.parent_code,
    c.child_kind,
    c.child_code,
    b.path_qty * c.qty AS path_qty
  FROM bom_explosion b
  JOIN u_composition c ON (
    -- sku -> model (non-bundle SKU maps to model)
    (b.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
    OR
    -- model -> component
    (b.child_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
    OR
    -- component -> component (assembly to sub-component)
    (b.child_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
  )
  WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
    AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT SUM(path_qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_explosion
WHERE child_kind = 'component'
  AND child_code = 'TAB-960-WAL-02843';
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- Start from all BOM edges that are current as of 2026-10-01
current_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_code, child_kind, child_code, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Find all paths from company models down to components (including through sub-assemblies)
model_to_component AS (
    -- Direct: company model -> component
    SELECT parent_code AS model_code, child_code AS component_code, qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model' AND child_kind = 'component'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Direct: company model -> assembly component
    SELECT parent_code AS model_code, child_code AS component_code, qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model' AND child_kind = 'component'
      AND child_code IN (SELECT component_code FROM component WHERE is_assembly = true)
),
-- Recursive traversal through assembly components
assembly_paths AS (
    -- Base: model -> component (any component, we'll filter assemblies in recursion)
    SELECT 
        cb.parent_code AS model_code,
        cb.child_code AS component_code,
        cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM current_bom cb
    WHERE cb.parent_kind = 'model' AND cb.child_kind = 'component'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: traverse through assembly components
    SELECT 
        ap.model_code,
        cb.child_code AS component_code,
        ap.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty
    FROM assembly_paths ap
    JOIN current_bom cb ON cb.parent_kind = 'component' AND cb.parent_code = ap.component_code AND cb.child_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = ap.component_code AND c.is_assembly = true
)
-- Count distinct company models that contain the target component at any level
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_code) AS model_count
FROM assembly_paths
WHERE component_code = 'CRO-671-GRY-02889'"}

-- First, find all SKUs that map directly to ER2-140GRY79-0370
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT s.sku_code, s.sku_id, 1 as qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.child_code = 'ER2-140GRY79-0370' AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),
-- Find all bundle SKUs and their item SKUs that eventually map to the model
bundle_paths AS (
    -- Start with bundles that contain SKUs
    SELECT 
        b.sku_code as bundle_sku_code,
        b.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,
        uc.child_code as item_sku_code,
        uc.qty as bundle_qty
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true
        AND uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),
-- Item SKUs that map to the model
item_skus_for_model AS (
    SELECT s.sku_code, s.sku_id, uc.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model' AND uc.child_code = 'ER2-140GRY79-0370'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),
-- Bundles that contain item SKUs mapping to the model
bundles_with_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.bundle_sku_code,
        bp.bundle_sku_id,
        bp.item_sku_code,
        bp.bundle_qty * ism.model_qty_per_sku as total_model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_paths bp
    JOIN item_skus_for_model ism ON ism.sku_code = bp.item_sku_code
),
-- All SKUs that contribute to the model with their quantities
all_contributing_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, qty_per_sku as model_qty_per_unit FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bundle_sku_id, bundle_sku_code, total_model_qty_per_bundle as model_qty_per_unit FROM bundles_with_model
)
-- Calculate total units sold
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * acs.model_qty_per_unit) as total_units_sold
FROM all_contributing_skus acs
JOIN listing l ON l.sku_id = acs.sku_id
JOIN order_line ol ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
